## Où j'en suis
PR #233 (branch lior/replay-12-11) is merged and the real replay is done: 18,442,107 events produced into `events.replay.v3` (3,118 schema-v2 rejects to S3). The aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 started at 08:57 UTC and was at 61% (~14.9M rows in ClickHouse vs ~20.5M expected) at last check; the incident stays open until counts match. (source: ses-rp-2, r2-01, r2-04, r2-06, r2-07)

- [en-cours] Aggregator backfill `backfill-2026-11-12` reading `events.replay.v3` — not finished at session end (source: r2-05, r2-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Wait for backfill completion, compare counts hour by hour (1% tolerance), then close the incident (source: r2-08, r2-10)
- [essai-raté] Dry run with 50k batches was OOMKilled (2Gi limit); 5k batches work, memory limit must not be raised (source: r1-03, r1-04, src-sentry-oom)
- [décision] Replay everything into `events.replay.v3`, never produce to `events.v3` from the tool (source: r1-02, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] Ignore PR #241 from the fork: Daniel owns the CI check as the official fix; Rachel told customers data back by Thursday (source: r2-07, r2-09, src-slack-incident, src-pr241-fork)
